sources.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 overview
sources.scope: Exterior dimensions, engine counts, fairing and recovery appendages.

sources.title: SpaceX Falcon User Guide, March 2025
sources.scope: Printed pp. 6, 8-9; tank order/feed tube, common dome, materials and attitude control. Table 2-1 uses 3.66 m diameter.

sources.title: SpaceX CRS-7 press kit (NASA-hosted), 2015
sources.scope: Printed p. 17 (PDF p. 19); historical Octaweb geometry. Not a current Block 5 detail drawing.

sources.title: NASA: A History of Collapse Factor Modeling and Empirical Data for Cryogenic Propellant Tanks
sources.scope: Review of pressurant/ullage gas collapse, heat and mass transfer, and increased pressurant requirements; background reference, not validation of this CAD.

sources.title: NASA: Cold Helium Gas Pressurization, 2017
sources.scope: Cryogenic pressurant storage, warming and gas cooling effects; LOX/methane test article, not Falcon.

sources.title: NASA: Zero-Boil-Off Tank experiments, 2024
sources.scope: Microgravity pressure control and interface/jet interaction; surrogate-fluid research, not full-scale LOX validation.

sources.title: NASA NTRS: ZBOT CFD validation, 2019
sources.scope: Candidate microgravity validation publication; exact case conditions/data extraction still required.

sources.title: NASA: Hypersonic cone-slice-flap CFD validation, 2023
sources.scope: Mach 6 force/moment benchmark; it does not independently validate heat flux.

sources.title: NASA PACE gallery
sources.scope: Exterior image KSC-20240205-PH-SPX01_0012; NASA/SpaceX gallery credit.

sources.title: Octaweb photograph: Steve Jurvetson, 2016
sources.scope: CC BY 2.0; Wikimedia mirror. Historical layout reference, not current Block 5 dimensional evidence.

sources.title: NASA: Mach 6 cone transition and heating, 2002
sources.scope: Candidate heat-transfer/transition benchmark. Match tunnel noise and wall conditions; extract test data before validation.

sources.title: NASA cryogenic fluid management roadmaps
sources.scope: Generic pressure-control diffusers, capillary and vacuum-insulation technologies; not Falcon drawings.

sources.title: NASA SHIIVER cryogenic insulation testing
sources.scope: Vacuum MLI and cryogenic insulation research context; not Falcon hardware.

context: Public background references and independent geometry assumptions. Selected sources revisited for the website case study; these are not manufacturer geometry validation.
